name: selection-chips
description: Use this skill when a node's code works on the rows a user selects in a view, by a brush or a click in a Vega-Lite chart or by a pick or a brush in an Autark map or plot. It says how a selection tag names its view and the column that identifies its rows, how dataflow.read lists the tags, and how code places a tag's reference to read the selected ids.
